== Summary ==

:{{pov|[[Aviendha]]}}
Unable to stand, Aviendha tries to crawl towards her gateway as [[Hessalam]] tries to shield her. She realizes she can't reach it and starts to unweave the gateway as Hessalam begins to weave compulsion. 

In her haste, Aviendha picks the wrong thread and the gateway explodes.

:{{pov|[[Padan Fain]]}}
Fain, thinking of himself as Shaisam, moves towards [[Rand al'Thor|Rand]]. He stops, as some of the mist which is a part of him has stopped sensing. 

He comes across what he believes to be a familiar corpse, killed by the mists, but it reaches up and grabs him by the throat. 

[[Matrim Cauthon|Mat]] tells him he once heard that if you catch a disease and survive, you can't get it again. Fain drops the dagger. Mat grabs it and rams it through Fain's heart. Fain finally dies, his flesh melting away.

:{{pov|[[Perrin Aybara]]}}
Perrin leaves Mat and enters the wolf dream. He grabs [[Gaul]] and takes him to the [[Two Rivers]] camp at the [[Field of Merrilor]]. 

He leaves Gaul to be [[Healing|Healed]] and returns to Shayol Ghul, as he knows Rand still needs him.

:{{pov|[[Rand al'Thor]]}}
[[Moridin]] grabs ''[[Callandor]]'' and realizes it is also a [[True Power]] ''[[sa'angreal]]'' and draws it through the sword. Rand tells him that to do so means death, but Moridin replied that he will have oblivion. 

[[El'Nynaeve ti al'Meara Mandragoran|Nynaeve]] and [[Moiraine Damodred|Moiraine]] exploit the flaw in ''Callandor'' in the way that [[Elmindreda Farshaw|Min]] had worked out and take control of Moridin, before linking with Rand. 

With ''[[saidin]]'', ''[[saidar]]'', and the True Power, Rand seizes the Dark One through the [[Bore]], using the protection of the True Power to prevent ''saidin'' from being tainted again. The Dark One tries to turn off access to the True Power but there is too much of it and he is unable to do anything. 

Light explodes from Rand.
